body:
## Problem

The token page's chart (#64) offers 15m, 4h and 1D intervals, but the API contract's `CandleInterval` stopped at 1h. The chart could only show those three from fixture-only data, and the candle builder (#80) had no contract to build them against. Temi decided the contract gains the three intervals rather than the chart dropping them.

## Fix

- `CandleInterval` gains `CANDLE_INTERVAL_15M = 5`, `CANDLE_INTERVAL_4H = 6` and `CANDLE_INTERVAL_1D = 7`, after the existing values, so nothing is renumbered (`scripts/proto-check.sh`, including `buf breaking` against main, passes). `stream.proto`'s topic comment lists the new labels.
- The TypeScript in `web/terminal/src/api/generated` is regenerated. The topic and REST labels (`CANDLE_INTERVAL_LABELS`) gain `15m`, `4h` and `1d`, so `topicKind` accepts `candles:<address>:15m` and the like.
- Fixtures: `src/mocks/fixtures/api/candles/{15m,4h,1d}.json` hold eight candles each, aligned to the interval and ending at the fixture head's time, with the last still open. MSW serves `GET /v1/candles?interval=` and each `candles:<address>:<interval>` topic from the interval's file, falling back to the `CandleSeries` message fixture for the others.
- `crates/candles/` isn't on main, so data.md says the builder must serve all seven intervals (#80 builds it). data.md and frontend.md list the new intervals.

## Acceptance criteria

| Criterion (from #124) | Proved by |
|---|---|
| "`CandleInterval` gains 15m, 4h and 1D values, added without renumbering existing values (`buf breaking` passes)." | manual: `proto/omnimarket/api/v1/market.proto` adds values 5, 6 and 7 after `CANDLE_INTERVAL_1H = 4`; `scripts/proto-check.sh` (buf lint, and buf breaking against origin/main) passes locally and in CI's `verify` |
| "The generated TypeScript in `web/terminal/src/api/generated` is regenerated and the staleness check passes." | manual: `npm run api:generate`, then `bash scripts/check-api-generated.sh` passes on the commit; CI's `frontend` job runs the same check |
| "MSW fixtures cover at least one candle series at each new interval." | `serves a candle series at each of the 15m, 4h and 1d intervals, spaced by the interval`, `serves each candle topic its interval's series`, `recognises the contract's topics and nothing else` |
| "If the candle builder (`crates/candles/`) exists on main when this is built, it can produce the new intervals; if not, `docs/spec/data.md` notes that the builder must support them." | manual: `crates/candles/` doesn't exist on main; `docs/spec/data.md`, "Candles" under ClickHouse and reorgs, says the builder serves all seven and #80 builds it |
| "`docs/spec/data.md` and `docs/spec/frontend.md` list the new intervals." | manual: data.md's API topics table and frontend.md's REST table and fixtures paragraph |

## Not verified

- The chart rendering the new intervals: #105 now limits its picker to the v0 intervals. Turning 15m, 4h and 1D back on is Jutin's change.
- No Rust changed, so there's no mutants run.

Closes #124
title: Add 15m, 4h and 1d candle intervals to the API contract
